referees.quote: I believe the work meets the high standards of Nature Communications and recommend publication after minor revision.
I do have serious concerns on both the experiments and interpretations. Therefore, I cannot recommend the publication of this manuscript, at least, not the current version.
However I do have some concerns regarding the interpretation of the presented data that would need to be sufficiently addressed before recommending publication.

note: The file shows no transfer from another journal, so the first round is Version 0. Only R1 names a category. R2 refuses publication 'at least, not the current version', which implies revision is possible. R2 also asks for experimental proof that the surface is not degraded, for gap temperature dependence and for checks on the flat band, so this is read as major revision rather than reject. R3 praises the data but raises a main concern about the central interpretation (unchanged inner-plane doping and absent outer-plane band splitting). R3 also asks for a fuller comparison with Bi2223 and Hg1223 and a discussion of the modelling, so this is inferred as major revision; it is borderline with minor revision. No referee co-signed another's report.
